messages: Maya: Quick heads-up noticed a recurring support ticket: users are clicking the copy icon and thinking it exports the trace. The drilldown toolbar is overloaded. Link to screenshot: https://imgur.com/redwood/trace-toolbar.png :eyes: Claire: Agree. We should collapse export actions behind a single "Export" menu and make the copy action explicit: label `Copy trace link` and show the short id underneath. Avoid icons-only for primary clipboard actions. Samir: Technical constraints: the trace is streamed and we only generate a permalink after the trace is fully materialized in storage. If we surface `Copy trace link` before permalink exists, it could mislead. Suggest disabling the copy until permalink ready and show a tooltip `permalink generating...`. ETA for permalink stage toggles is ~3 dev days. Diego: From a product POV we want minimal friction. Alternative: copy a temporary short id that resolves once permalink is ready, show `Copy trace id (temporary)` and then replace with full link in the toast when available. That keeps the action available. Thoughts on privacy: temporary ids must expire in 24h. Anne: Accessibility notes: keep the copy button reachable at the start of the toolbar tab order. Use aria-live to announce state changes (disabled -> ready). Example: ``` Permalink generating ``` Claire: Microcopy: prefer short, direct verbs. Use sentence case: `Copy trace link`, toast: `Trace link copied View trace`. For exports menu items use `Download JSON`, `Download CSV`, `Copy permalink`. Samir: Also recommend adding a small confirmation area that shows the actual copied string in monospace so users can verify/save it. For large teams, exposing full `request:/span/path` in exports should be opt-in. Default to short ids. Priya: I'll run keyboard + screen reader checks on staging once Samir's branch lands. Specific checks: (a) ability to copy with keyboard only, (b) live region announcements, (c) contrast and focus ring on the toolbar. I can test on NVDA and VoiceOver. deploy-bot: Updated trace-toolbar copy toast wording in staging at 2024-05-07T11:12:00Z :white_check_mark: Maya: Nice. Action items: Claire to update Figma with export menu + disabled-state tooltip; Samir to prototype temporary-id flow + aria updates; Diego to confirm expiry policy; Anne to review keyboard order; Priya to run a11y sweep. I'll follow up after staging pass. Thanks all.
